VIDEO SCRIPT: TRADE AND FINANCE IN ISLAM
Grade: Grade 7 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Trade and Finance in Islam. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• identify the halal and haram sources of earning for legitimate livelihood
• describe the legitimate ways of spending income to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s Pleasure
• explain the importance of lawful earnings as an act of ibadah
• apply the knowledge of the halal way of earning in daily life, g) appreciate halal sources of earning and spending as a fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s command

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: identify the halal and haram sources of earning for legitimate livelihood
• Model 2: describe the legitimate ways of spending income to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s Pleasure
• Model 3: explain the importance of lawful earnings as an act of ibadah
• Model 4: apply the knowledge of the halal way of earning in daily life, g) appreciate halal sources of earning and spending as a fulfilment of Allah (S.W.T.)’s command

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: identify the halal and haram sources of earning for legitimate livelihood
• Practise: describe the legitimate ways of spending income to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s Pleasure
• Practise: explain the importance of lawful earnings as an act of ibadah

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Trade and Finance in Islam.”
